notes.title: Summer has started! New update is out!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[h1]Summer has started in the world of Dodge Diego which means that we've updated the game with a nice little visual change to get out some summer vibes. [/h1]

Also it seems like a new type of enemy has appeared so keep an eye out for a special bird which will only be available during the summer time!

We'll be looking forward to the next seasonal update and hope that you will enjoy the current one!:Heartyou:


Happy dodging! :al_star:

notes.title: Update News: Jump Delay Fix
notes.content:
Hey!


We just launched an update with adjustments to the jumping mechanic, because many of you criticized that the delay of falling back to the ground was too long. We changed the delay from 1.75s to only 1.25s, which should make the game feel much more responsive.

If you have further wishes or critique, please let us know!


Happy dodging! ːsteamhappyː
